title: Multiplicity of Solutions to the Brezis-Nirenberg Problem on Hyperbolic Spaces
summary: This article investigates the multiplicity of solutions to the Brezis-Nirenberg problem on smooth bounded domains in the hyperbolic space $\mathbb{B}^N$ for $N \ge 4$. Specifically, we study the critical semilinear equation $-Δ_{\mathbb{B}^N} u = λu + |u|^{2^*-2}u$ under Dirichlet boundary conditions for $λ> \frac{N(N-2)}{4}$. Overcoming the analytic challenges induced by the hyperbolic geometry and the intricate concentration profiles of Palais-Smale sequences, we establish the existence of multiple pairs of nontrivial solutions.
